jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods

• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics

• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)

• Can work in a 2-shift system

• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments

• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

A project on paper is one thing. Making sure it actually works? That’s a whole different story.

For an international player in automation and intralogistics, we are looking for a Project Manager to manage complex projects from A to Z.

You bring together technology, people, planning and budgets, making sure everything comes together at the right time. From kick-off to final delivery, you keep the overview and step in whenever adjustments are needed.

International projects, a lot of responsibility, and technology that you literally see in motion.

Functieomschrijving
 
• You manage international projects within robotics and industrial automation from A to Z, from kick-off to final delivery. 
• You set up and closely monitor project schedules, budgets and deadlines, making adjustments where needed to ensure successful project delivery. 
• You monitor the project’s quality, scope and risks and proactively anticipate potential changes or challenges throughout the execution. 
• You ensure strong collaboration and transparent communication with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, while leading meetings and project reporting.
 

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a technical or industrial environment. 

• You are a strong communicator, hands-on and independent, and you enjoy taking ownership of your projects and results. 

• You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or German is a plus. 

• You are willing to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Accountant to join the Finance team in Leuven.

In this role, you will be a key pillar of our 6-member financial department, taking ownership of accounting tasks from A to Z.

To succeed, you must be experienced in Belgian and familiar with international accounting principles, highly analytical, and possess an high attention to detail. Your goal will be to drive the overall efficiency of our financial operations, ensure the accuracy and compliance of the day-to-day accounting and manage the month end closing process.

• Support the AP accountant with incoming invoices in accordance with Belgian accounting and VAT principles
• Manage the AP invoice approval cycle efficiently.
• Take ownership of the AP accounting for our subsidiaries (Germany, The Netherlands, UK, Finland, and Singapore). 
• Support bookings and meticulously reconcile bank statements.
• Register journal entries payroll bookings for Belgium and international entities.
• Manage fixed assets and book depreciations across all subsidiaries.
• Register prepaid expenses, accruals, and provisions.
• Prepare and file Belgian VAT returns, as well as VAT filings for foreign subsidiaries.
• Lead the monthly closing process for all corporate entities.
• Assist with group-level financial reconciliations, consolidation and reporting.
 

• Education: minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Finance, Accountancy) or equivalent experience.
• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with Belgian accounting rules and VAT.
• Languages: Excellent command of English (spoken and written) alongside a good working knowledge of Dutch.
• Skills: Strong analytical acumen, great comfort with numbers, and an uncompromising attention to detail.
• Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of Belgian accounting and financial reporting practices. Advanced knowledge of MS Office is required.
• Pluses: Previous experience with NetSuite and/or Salesforce is considered a strong asset.

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

For our client, an international organization in Heverlee , we are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead the AP team. In this key role, you will ensure the accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, maintain compliance with accounting and tax regulations and drive continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead, coach, and develop the Accounts Payable team.
• Oversee the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
• Coordinate invoice processing, payment runs, and AP-related financial controls.
• Manage monthly closing activities, reconciliations, accruals, and follow-up of outstanding items.
• Ensure compliance with VAT, tax, and internal accounting policies.
• Act as the main point of contact for AP-related matters across multiple stakeholders.
• Identify and implement process improvements, standardization initiatives, and automation opportunities.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent through experience.
• Several years of experience in Accounts Payable within a multinational or complex organization.
• Strong SAP knowledge; experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus.
• Solid understanding of VAT and accounting regulations.
• Proven experience leading and developing teams.
• Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

After completing the management trainee program, you will be assigned to a full-time position in Sales.

The client's management trainee program is designed for recent university graduates who are highly motivated and have the potential to excel as future global leaders at the company. The training program is customized to meet the skills of the employee along with the needs of the company.

It offers challenging work assignments along with hands on training in manufacturing, quality control, administration, sales & marketing, and logistics. You will be exposed to all areas of the business and learn by successfully completing various projects in the different departments.

• A master or bachelor degree.

• 2 years of previous work experiences.
• A fluent pen and verbal skills in English and Dutch. Any additional languages would be great.
• Able to work autonomously, in a structured and efficient way.

Join Logent in Evergem as a reach truck driver in a 2-shift system or a fixed night shift earning €16,37 per hour, great shift extras and €10 meal vouchers. 

Looking for a stable warehouse role where your precision on the reach truck makes an immediate impact? At Logent, every workday brings clear processes, a supportive team culture, and excellent working conditions. As a reach truck driver, you keep our logistics supply chain moving smoothly and safely every single day.

Looking for a long term experience? Apply today via talentcenter40@randstad.be or 09 218 79 35.

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for for this vacancy?

• You are an experienced reach truck driver holding an up-to-date driver certificate.
• You communicate fluently in English to ensure safe operations and smooth teamwork.
• You have your own reliable transport to reach our Evergem facilities on schedule.
• You are comfortable working in a 2-shift or fixed night system and fit within our collective leave schedule (3 weeks in late July/early August and the Christmas period).
Your responsibilities as a reach truck driver: 

• Operating reach trucks safely to stack, store, and transfer goods in high-bay racks.
• Loading and unloading freight trucks carefully while maintaining damage-free handling.
• Inspecting incoming shipments for quality and raising reports with your supervisor when needed.
• Staging inventory for order picking teams to prevent operational bottlenecks.
• Maintaining order, cleanliness, and safety standards across your workspace.

Are you passionate about global brands and eager to support their development across international markets? Join our team as Global Brand Packaging Specialist, where your organizational skills and project management expertise will be key to driving our brands’ success internationally. 
 

Over de functie:

• For each project you oversee the project lifecyle, from concept to launch, and manage the different process steps. You collect the necessary data and translations from internal stakeholders, guide the conversion of design concepts into artwork, ensure readiness for print and adherence to market regulations.

Leading the Transition from Java to .NET to Build Innovative Digital Platforms.

The company is the leader in media production servers and live content management.

As a Software Engineer (with .Net seniority) you actively participate in the various steps of the development process: analysis, architecture, design, implementation, testing, documentation, and maintenance. You work in a self-organized cross-functional Development Team in an Agile and fast-paced dynamic environment.
Role
• Analyze and review product requirements, and discuss the technical feasibility
• Build technical design proposals
• Develop new software components or modify existing ones
• Participate in peer code reviews
• Plan, define and perform unit testing
• Create or maintain technical documentation
• Integrate individual software components developed by yourself and other members of the development team
• Solve defects reported in the defect tracking system
• Maintain existing applications
• Identify risks and discuss them with the Quality Control department for building adequate test plans
• Make work estimates for the tasks assigned to you
• Plan, track and report your daily work and your assigned tasks to your direct manager
• Follow the software development process (Source Control Management, Defect Tracking, Coding Rules, Continuous Integration)
• Identify and propose process improvements
• Coach and guide junior team members
Profile
Technical skills:

• Knowledge or experience in Object-Oriented Design and Programming
• Advanced knowledge in .NET and especially .NET Core
• Understanding of the full software life cycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, and maintenance
• Experience with CI/CD software is a plus (preferably TeamCity)
• Experience in Agile Application Development & Scrum methodologies is a plus
• Engineer, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science (high school or university)
• 5 years of experience in a similar position
Soft skills:

• Focus on quality, detail-minded, willing to take care of customer point of view
• Critical but constructive mindset focused on delivery constraints and pragmatism
• Open for changes and continuous learning
• Shows initiative, is curious, and communicates well about initiatives
• Good written and verbal communication skills share information actively; respond properly, reports on time; accept criticism and other opinions, addresses criticism constructively
• Excellent team player
• Stress resistance; does not give up in crisis situation; does not lose control under pressure
• Aligned with company values : Innovation, Passion, Excellence, Agility, Accountability, Teamwork, and Customer Success
Languages:

• Working knowledge of English
• Knowledge of French is an asset
